title: Brain Construction Schedule Explorer
description: Side-profile brain whose clickable regions fill with color as they mature along an age slider, showing back-to-front development with the prefrontal region last, a fixed-schedule life-demands track, and an ADHD toggle that delays only the prefrontal region.
creator: Arun Batchu
subject: ADHD
Brain Development
Prefrontal Cortex
Maturation
audience: People with ADHD, Family members, Students, Educators

controls.label: Brain regions
